description: This course introduces students to the principles and practices of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) using Java. Topics include classes and objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and design patterns such as Singleton and Factory. Students will explore Java's standard libraries, including collections framework, I/O operations, and exception handling. The course also covers algorithmic complexity analysis, Big O notation, and the use of Java's built-in data structures like ArrayList and HashMap. Additional topics include the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), memory management, and the use of Java in enterprise applications via frameworks like Spring Boot. Students will also study object-oriented design principles such as SOLID and UML modeling for software development.

clos.text: Define the core principles of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), including encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, using Java syntax and design patterns.
Describe the Java Collections Framework, including ArrayList, HashMap, and TreeSet, and demonstrate their usage in implementing data structures.
Explain the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) architecture, garbage collection mechanisms, and memory management techniques in Java applications.
Apply OOP concepts to design and implement a multi-tiered enterprise application using Spring Boot and Java's standard libraries.
Implement a software system using UML modeling techniques and design patterns such as Singleton, Factory, and Observer to ensure scalability and maintainability.

labs: Create a Java class with encapsulation and access modifiers
Implement a hierarchy of classes with inheritance and polymorphism
Implement a data structure using ArrayList and HashMap
Implement a file I/O application with exception handling
Use Java Streams to process and filter data
Implement a multithreaded application with synchronization
Create a simple client-server application using sockets
Perform file system operations using Java NIO
Use Java reflection to inspect and modify class metadata

topics: Java memory management and JVM internals
labs: Analyze JVM memory usage using JVM tools
Develop a RESTful API using Spring Boot
Model a software system using UML and implement a design pattern
Write unit tests for Java applications using JUnit
